verses.name: Psalms 23:1
verses.text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

verses.name: Psalms 23:2
verses.text: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

verses.name: Psalms 23:3
verses.text: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.name: Psalms 23:4
verses.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.name: Psalms 23:5
verses.text: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

verses.name: Psalms 23:6
verses.text: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
